rationale: The report captures all facts but fails to map the compressor to its registry ID (M-12) and treats the air tools as a separate entity rather than a related issue. It fabricates several recommendations and monitoring steps not present in the input. It also fails to flag the contradiction between the compressor running normally and the tools losing pressure.
